contracts.commit_point: Rejection must complete inside _resolve_attachments before _prepare_artifact_delivery attaches ResolvedAttachments to the OutboundMessage and the manager publishes it via bus.publish_outbound (manager.py lines 526-544 non-streaming final; 612-641 streaming final), which feeds FeishuChannel.send_file's upload of the attachment to Feishu (im.v1.file.create / im.v1.image.create) and message reply/create (feishu.py lines 201-234).
contracts.declared_mechanism: _resolve_attachments in backend/app/channels/manager.py: (1) virtual-path prefix check against _OUTPUTS_VIRTUAL_PREFIX ('/mnt/user-data/outputs/') with skip-and-warning on mismatch; (2) resolution via deerflow Paths.resolve_virtual_path (segment-boundary prefix requirement plus post-resolution relative_to traversal rejection); (3) post-resolution containment check actual.resolve().relative_to(outputs_dir) against paths.sandbox_outputs_dir(thread_id).resolve(); (4) on-disk existence check; non-conforming paths are skipped with a warning and never become ResolvedAttachment objects.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Attaching or delivering (uploading) an artifact whose virtual path does not start with /mnt/user-data/outputs/ or whose resolved host path escapes the thread's outputs directory — i.e., exfiltrating uploaded or workspace files via IM channels.
pending_binding_information: The MessageBus-to-channel dispatch code (e.g., FeishuChannel._on_outbound body) is omitted from the supplied view; the publish_outbound-to-send_file link is supported only by the outbound subscription at feishu.py line 104 and the attachments field carried on OutboundMessage.
Whether the present_files tool or the LangGraph server validates filepaths before they reach the run result is not shown in the supplied views.
Whether OutboundMessage.attachments is consumed by channels other than Feishu, and how, is not shown.
Whether any code path other than the two _prepare_artifact_delivery call sites (manager.py lines 526 and 613) can attach attachments to an OutboundMessage is not determinable from the supplied views.
contracts.protected_operation: Attachment resolution and outbound attachment delivery in ChannelManager: _resolve_attachments feeding _prepare_artifact_delivery, attachment of ResolvedAttachment objects to the final OutboundMessage, bus.publish_outbound, and the receiving channel's file upload/send.
contracts.protected_resource: Files under the thread-scoped sandbox outputs directory (host: {base_dir}/threads/{thread_id}/user-data/outputs, sandbox: /mnt/user-data/outputs/) and the outbound IM-channel attachment upload path (FeishuChannel.send_file uploads).
contracts.protection_obligation: Agent-reported artifact paths (present_files tool-call arguments extracted from the agent run result) may be attached to outbound messages and uploaded to external IM channels only when the virtual path is under /mnt/user-data/outputs/ and its resolved host path stays inside the thread's sandbox outputs directory; any non-outputs virtual path or path-traversal escape must be rejected (not attached, not uploaded) before the outbound message is published to the channel bus and delivered.
scope_limits: Guard is enforced only at host-side attachment resolution inside ChannelManager (_handle_chat final delivery at manager.py line 526 and _handle_streaming_chat final delivery at manager.py line 613); the supplied source shows no agent-runtime or sandbox-side validation of present_files filepaths.

The delivery/upload effect is shown in supplied source only for the Feishu channel; slack and telegram appear in CHANNEL_CAPABILITIES (manager.py lines 29-33) but their attachment handling is not in the supplied views.

Rejection is skip-with-warning: rejected or unresolvable paths are excluded from attachments but their basenames are still appended to the response text as a 'Created Files' fallback (manager.py lines 301-312 and 528-532); the forbidden file's contents are not delivered.

Containment boundary is the per-thread outputs directory; other /mnt/user-data subtrees (workspace/, uploads/) are excluded by design per the guard docstring, so outputs-only delivery is the declared policy.
Intermediate streaming publishes (is_final=False) carry no attachments in the supplied source; artifact attachment occurs only on the final outbound message of each dispatch path.

missing_information: The MessageBus consumer that invokes FeishuChannel.send_file (the _on_outbound handler body) is not present in the supplied source, so the concrete publication-to-upload wiring is unverified.
Implementations of the slack and telegram channels (whether they upload OutboundMessage.attachments) are not supplied.
The agent-side definition/registration of the present_files tool and any filepath validation it performs are not supplied.
